en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Orthodox church with two bell towers on the left façade and a prominent central dome. The architecture features arched windows and decorative brickwork. There are a few people and trees in the foreground. Handwritten text in Greek appears along the left edge, and printed vertical Greek text identifying the location appears on the right side. At the bottom is a modern watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr".
